svg.text: Sentry Agent Tracing: Conversation Linkage & Span Hierarchy
From Sentry Agent Tracing Docs & Search Query Assistant post: stitching multi-request turns to trace silent tool & API faults
Flat LLM Monitoring
Flat isolated calls (prompt, tokens, cost)
Blind spots: silent empty tool returns, loops, lost handoff state, DB lag
Agent Span Hierarchy
Cross-request chat + per-trace span tree
Unifies LLM, tool, handoff & HTTP/DB spans inside one distributed trace
Conversation Container: gen_ai.conversation.id stitches multi-request turns
Request Trace #1 · gen_ai.invoke_agent (functionId: "chat-agent" aggregates children)
gen_ai.chat (ai_client)
LLM step (doc example: sonnet-5 · 340 tokens · $0.002 · 800ms)
gen_ai.execute_tool
Tool I/O (e.g. read_file 42ms; silent empty result without error)
http.client / db.query
Nested backend spans (doc example: 75% of run latency in check)
Agent Handoff Span
Triage → Billing context handoff (catch dropped order ID)
Request Trace #2 · Same gen_ai.conversation.id (Turn 2, separate distributed trace)
• Explore → Agents stitches turns into one transcript with links into each request waterfall
• Caveat: 1 chat ≠ 1 trace; summing raw invoke_agent + child spans double-counts totals
Case Study: Search Query Assistant
Symptom: numeric queries return 0 hits
Trace jump: AI Conversation → API trace
Root cause: bare field name in prompt
bug__predictions_count → tags[..., number]
Loop: local evals sent to Sentry pre-PR
Privacy & Sampling Gate (Coverage)
• JS SDK v11+ captures I/O by default
• Sensitive routes set recordInputs: false
• Opt-outs, sampling & scrub yield null rows
(Core docs also note opt-in sensitivity policies)
Engineering Principle: Correlated Spans Expose What Happened, Not Why It Is Correct
1) Doc numbers (340 tokens, $0.002, 800ms, 42ms, 75%) are pedagogical illustrations, not benchmarks; 2) Local evals share prod UI
3) Observability compounds only when wired into downstream workflows (eval exports, triage, cost attribution, alerts & OTel)
Assistant diagram (not an original figure) synthesized from Sentry Agent Tracing Docs, Search Query Assistant blog (2026-09-11) & Cookbooks
